title: AB Patterns
short: Find what comes next in an AB pattern.

blocks.html: A pattern repeats again and again. Red, blue, red, blue … What comes next? Red! Say it out loud and you can hear it.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Red, blue, red, blue, red … what comes next?

blocks.html: In an AB pattern, two things take turns.

For the grown-up: Make patterns with your body: clap, stomp, clap, stomp. Use blocks or beads: red, blue, red, blue. Ask your child to keep it going, then to make one for you. A few problems on the screen is plenty. The real practice is with things you can touch.

items: Try it at home: Clap, tap, clap, tap.
Make a bead or noodle necklace that repeats.
Find patterns on clothes or tiles.
